name: portable-vna-desktop
description: Portable VNA phase-one Electron operator console

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s command-electron -n renderer,electron-ts,electron -c cyan,magenta,green "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main/index.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && vite build
